evidence.title: loki-mode README.md
evidence.locator: Install; First run; What you get; Models/providers; Control Plane; Requirements
evidence.finding: Local coding factory starts from a task/PRD/issue, builds/verifies and seals a signed receipt before PR publication. Current providers are Claude Code/Agent SDK and OpenCode. Codex/Cline/Aider/Gemini are removed.

evidence.title: loki-mode docs/CLI-CORE-VERBS.md
evidence.finding: CLI starts and inspects runs, chat steers/controls attached runs. Detached run survives terminal/logout but needs host kept awake; self-hosted runner is recommended for closed-laptop continuity.

evidence.title: loki-mode docs/control-plane-migration.md
evidence.locator: Current UI; Start the Control Plane; Route mapping; Not yet available
evidence.finding: Control Plane replaces classic dashboard, with /v1 run list/detail/events/artifacts, start/stop/resume/retry/verify/answer and merge queue/risk routes. Current UI has one bearer token, not RBAC/OIDC; machine-mutating routes are loopback-only.

evidence.title: loki-mode docs/TOOL-INTEGRATION.md
evidence.finding: Product exposes an MCP stdio integration and API/editor clients; file-based memory/events coordinate tools. Legacy dashboard API is distinct from current Control Plane UI.

evidence.title: loki-mode docs/WORKSPACES.md
evidence.finding: Workspace groups repos with after dependencies and default concurrency two. Independent repos run concurrently in worktrees; dependent repos skip if predecessors fail. Integration can gate stages and signed composite binds child receipts/head SHAs/log digest.

evidence.title: loki-mode docs/DOCKER.md
evidence.finding: Docker wrapper mounts repo .loki state and provider credentials. Claude Max/Pro login reuse documented; older dashboard-port examples are not current UI authority.

evidence.title: loki-mode CHANGELOG.md
evidence.finding: Newest release changes would-be ambiguous stops into best-reading work capped at PARTIAL, with optional tool-less Opus consult. This is narrower/newer than README wording saying such runs stop to ask.

evidence.title: loki-mode docs/AGENT-CHANGE-RECEIPT.md
evidence.locator: Fields; Verify the signature; DSSE export
evidence.finding: Receipt schema binds task hash, base/head/tree/diff hashes, check outcomes, not_proven, cost/time and event-log digest to Ed25519 signature. Unrecorded cost/time fields remain unknown.

evidence.title: loki-mode docs/SIGNED-RECEIPTS.md
evidence.locator: What deploy gate trusts; Honest limits
evidence.finding: Deploy verifies signature against trusted key set. Signature proves origin/integrity, not correctness; post-deploy health and rollback status are separate recorded facts.

evidence.title: loki-mode LICENSE
evidence.locator: BUSL-1.1 parameters; Additional Use Grant; Change Date
evidence.finding: Source-available BUSL-1.1, not open source. Additional Use Grant allows specified personal/internal/academic/evaluation production use subject to terms; competing commercial services require license. Change date March 19 2030, with Apache-2.0 change license.

evidence.title: loki-mode docs/OPEN-CORE-BOUNDARY.md
evidence.finding: Existing self-hosted core is free and fully functional with no Loki account/license key/hosted backend. Paid hosted/enterprise layers are future additive seams, not evidence of existing product availability.

evidence.title: loki-mode docs/PRIVACY.md
evidence.finding: Anonymous diagnostics default on for interactive individual installs, auto-off in CI/enterprise/air-gap/noninteractive contexts; documented CLI/environment opt-outs. Provider network traffic governed separately.

evidence.title: loki-mode docs/examples/loki-issue-to-pr.yml.example
evidence.locator: Example issue and comment triggers; separate agent/publish jobs
evidence.finding: Official copyable workflow reacts to a loki issue label or authorized /loki comment, with per-issue concurrency. Read-only agent job emits patch; separate publisher job opens PR. User must install/configure this GitHub integration.

evidence.title: loki-mode skills/fixtures/demo-receipt/README.md
evidence.finding: Bundled receipt verification returned VERIFIED and the product tour tampered-copy check returned TAMPERED in a credential-free sandbox. This checks the sample verifier, not a fresh coding task.
evidence.method: Ran the released npm v11.138.0 loki tour in a Linux Landlock filesystem sandbox with seccomp denying outbound connect; no provider/network credentials.
evidence.configuration: Bun 1.3.14, telemetry disabled, outbound connect denied, filesystem restricted to runtime directories and a temporary fixture. No user credential directories accessible.
evidence.fixture: Unmodified bundled demo-receipt receipt.json/events.jsonl/pubkey.jwk; tour changes one byte in a temporary copy for its negative check.
evidence.result: Original sample VERIFIED; modified copy TAMPERED. No live model task or PR was run.

evidence.title: Loki Mode README, providers
evidence.locator: README.md line 127 (providers paragraph), release tag v11.138.0 (commit d05e200)
evidence.finding: The README states that two providers are supported, Claude Code (claude CLI or Agent SDK) and OpenCode; codex, cline, aider and gemini were removed and exit with a migration message.
